aspect: Missing the events that constitute a family
description: Funerals, births, graduations and illnesses happen without him, and the absences accumulate into not having been there for any of it.
energy_note: Absent from every photograph for eleven years.

aspect: He belongs fully to neither place
description: REP-004's pocho problem in Mexico and REP-001's hombre problem in the US leave no location where he is simply unremarkable.

aspect: The return that keeps not happening
description: The plan to go back in two years is renewed annually for twenty, which is its own specific grief and is extremely common.
energy_note: Going home in two years, every year, for twenty.

description: His father's funeral, held up to a camera by his sister so he can watch. The signal drops twice. Afterwards people tell him it was beautiful and that his father talked about him constantly, which is the part he cannot put down.
energy_note: Watched his father's funeral on a phone held up by his sister.
